# ModDB — Gravitr’s gameplay modification

- Original source: [Game mod](https://www.moddb.com/mods/mod-by-gravitr)
- Author / publication: Gravitr; ModDB; additional comments by community members.
- Language / date: English; listed release 2021, downloadable file dated 2021-05-11.
- Access: Mod description and first displayed comment page inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Gravitr describes changes to enemy levels, health, allied attack rates, widescreen profiles, and several missions’ lighting or weather. Robin’s punch is strengthened, and the first Lincoln map’s arrow targets are disabled. These are deliberate alterations, not a description of the original game’s balance.

The author says the mod was made using HxD. A later guest comment claims map images use bzip2 compression beginning at offset twelve and a sixteen-bit color representation; that account was not tested. The download listing also flags a possible Ranulph mission loading crash in some languages. The archive was not downloaded or executed.
